description: React component for sidebar category sorting menu in Mattermost, including sorting options and preferences management.

classes.name: SidebarCategorySortingMenu
classes.description: React memoized component for managing sidebar category sorting options, including sorting by alphabet or recency, and visibility preferences.

methods.name: handleSortDirectMessages
methods.description: Dispatches action to set sorting method for direct messages in a category.

methods.name: handlelimitVisibleDMsGMs
methods.description: Saves user preference for the number of visible direct message and group message chats.

methods.name: handleMenuToggle
methods.description: Updates component state to reflect menu open/close status.
